description: Deterministic De Belly reversal and alternating-gradient tracking titration across mechanochemical arm perturbations.

metadata.input_peak_definition: maximum Rac activation added at the high-input boundary; basal Rac activation is 1 and maximum mechanical increment is 0.2
metadata.purpose: locate input strengths at which reciprocal mechanochemical-arm perturbations become distinguishable
metadata.reversal_policy: same 250-s conditioning, 25-s cross-fade, and 500-s follow-up as the Phase 1 production assay
metadata.tracking_policy: same lengths, periods, six cycles, and first-cycle exclusion as the Phase 1 production assay
